capture: Chromium on macOS. Desktop 1440x1000, phone 390x844, short phone 320x568. MP4s are normal-speed encodes of browser-recorded WebM; no timing edits. Not physical-device or user-acceptance evidence.
verification: 20 Chromium tests passed (1.1m), including two normal-speed recordings. The two timer/reduced-motion checks passed again after expanding wraparound and pause-preservation assertions. The initial autoplay test failed on the manual-only baseline. A temporary browser-response mutation forced playback under reduced motion and correctly failed the still-image assertion; the mutation was removed and the same check passed.
visibilityBoundary: The hidden-tab test supplies the visibility property and event in the browser. Offscreen suspension uses actual page scrolling and IntersectionObserver delivery. This does not claim an OS tab-backgrounding test.
